title: Cerberus Architectural & Frontend Configuration Schema
description: Configuration schema for Cerberus Architectural Firewall and Frontend AST Engine

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URL or path

layers.description: Dictionary of architectural layers and their topology rules

allowed_deps.description: List of internal layers this layer is permitted to import

forbidden_deps.description: List of internal layers strictly forbidden from being imported

allowed_external.description: List of external SDK crates permitted in this layer (e.g. ['tauri'])

forbidden_external.description: List of external SDK crates strictly forbidden in this layer (e.g. ['reqwest', 'tokio', 'tauri'])

description.description: Human-readable purpose and architectural boundary description

sla.description: Service Level Agreements for architectural health and testability

min_testability_score.description: Minimum acceptable Testability Index (TI) composite score

max_violations_warning.description: Maximum tolerated warning-level violations before CI failure

max_violations_deny.description: Maximum tolerated deny-level violations before CI failure

frontend.description: Frontend (Vue 3, TypeScript, CSS) AST & FSD Governance

enforce_shallow_ref.description: Enforce shallowRef for large collections, AST, and foreign instances

ban_deep_watcher.description: Ban unconstrained watch(..., { deep: true }) causing reactivity storms

max_dom_nodes_threshold.description: Threshold of DOM elements before virtual scrolling is mandated

enforce_raii_cleanup.description: Ensure symmetrical cleanup of IPC listeners and timers in onUnmounted

hierarchy.description: Ordered slice hierarchy from top to bottom

css.description: Scoped CSS and Design Token rules

ban_raw_rgb.description: Prohibit direct rgb() and rgba() function calls

ban_named_colors.description: Prohibit named HTML colors (red, black, white, blue)

enforce_design_tokens.description: Require all color values to use CSS custom properties var(--color-*)

limits.description: Structural AST code size and complexity thresholds

max_file_loc.description: Maximum allowed lines of code per file

max_fn_loc.description: Maximum allowed lines of code per function

max_cyclomatic_complexity.description: Maximum allowed cyclomatic complexity per function

max_cognitive_complexity.description: Maximum allowed cognitive complexity per function

max_fn_params.description: Maximum allowed parameter count per function
